entities.name: Bishop Jerren
entities.description: Human cleric of Innistrad, bishop of Sigarda and secret Skirsdag cultist who abused orphans.

entities.name: Heron's Grace Orphanage
entities.description: Orphanage where Jerren abused the boys in his care.

entities.name: Tim
entities.description: Orphan who attacked Jerren after being turned into a werewolf.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel whose church Jerren served as bishop.

entities.name: Lunarch council
entities.description: Council Jerren partly sat on and then handed to Ormendahl.

entities.name: Skirsdag Cult
entities.description: Demon-worshipping cult Jerren secretly belonged to.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Demon whose restoration Jerren dedicated his life to; defeated by Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: Demon who told Jerren to dedicate the cult to him and took the Lunarch Council's reins.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Battle in which Jerren and the Council were killed.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: Period before which Jerren served Griselbrand's restoration.

events.summary: Tim, an orphan turned werewolf, attacks Bishop Jerren.
Liliana Vess defeats Griselbrand and Jerren grows despondent.
events.quote: When Liliana Vess defeated Griselbrand, Jerren grew despondent and suggestible

events.summary: Ormendahl instructs Jerren to dedicate the cult to him, and Jerren obliges.
Jerren steps down from the Lunarch Council, handing it to Ormendahl.
events.quote: Jerren stepped down from his position on the Lunarch Council

events.summary: Jerren is killed along with the rest of the Council at the Battle of Thraben.
events.quote: Jerren was killed along with the rest of the Council during the Battle of Thraben

relations.quote: he was also a secret member of the demon
instructing Jerren to dedicate the cult to him instead
